card.name: Inside thrombo- words and NS5A positions
card.fires_on: The pole responds partway through thrombo- words (thrombophlebitis, thromboembolic, thrombosis), on 'throm' or 'bo'. It also responds to the digit 3 in the list of NS5A amino acid positions '28, 30, 31'.

modes.label: Thrombo- words
modes.description: The 'throm' or 'bo' piece inside thrombophlebitis, thromboembolism or thromboembolic.

modes.label: NS5A positions
modes.description: The digit 3 starting position 30 in a list of resistance-associated amino acid positions.

card.writes: It mainly suppresses 'account' tokens and promotes odd name-like pieces, so there is no clear useful output effect.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of clot-related words like thromboembolism, and on the number 30 in hepatitis C resistance position lists.
